title: Rosemary's Baby
author: Ira Levin
summary: A young couple move into a New York apartment building with overly friendly neighbours. When Rosemary becomes pregnant, she begins to suspect that those around her have plans for the child.
readIf: you like paranoid horror where the menace comes from the people closest to you.
skipIf: you want a lot of gore or scares, because this is slow-burning dread.

pairings.reason: Another 1970s classic that mixes domestic life with a terrifying supernatural threat.
A modern gothic about a young woman who senses something rotten in a house and family.
A shorter, ambiguous classic about whether the menace is real.
